summary.text: Emily Kinkead is a Democratic member of the Pennsylvania House of Representatives for District 20, which she has represented since December 2020, and is running for re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is an attorney.

paragraphs.text: Kinkead was born in Pittsburgh, Pennsylvania, and graduated from Red River High School.
She earned a bachelor's degree from Bloomsburg University of Pennsylvania in 2009 and a J.D. from the University of Pittsburgh School of Law in 2013.
She has been affiliated with ALCOSAN and the Pennsylvania Prison Society.
Kinkead assumed office in the House on December 1, 2020, succeeding Adam Ravenstahl.
